name: horos-connector
description: Radiology Agent shared DICOM viewer, report editor and per-study Codex runs, backed by Horos. Not for medical use, research only.

interface.shortDescription: Watch Codex review DICOM studies in Radiology Agent.
interface.longDescription: A shared Cornerstone3D viewer and continuous report editor for the Radiology Agent Mac app and Codex browser panel. Original DICOM from Horos, visible browser tools, and a separate Codex task for each incoming study.
defaultPrompt: Find a study in Horos and prepare it for review.
Check the incoming worklist and draft evaluation reports.
Show all series in the selected Horos study.
